description: Dark Pattern Contract & Subscription Exit Lawyer — Paste a contract or Terms URL and get the decision first: send notice by a computed date, or the window has passed. Quotes auto-renewal, notice-window and early-termination traps verbatim, computes the renewal and last-notice dates in code, estimates the renewal cost you avoid from your fee, maps the exit to ROSCA, state automatic-renewal laws and EU/UK consumer law with links, and drafts a notice

annualFee.description: What you pay per year, USD, if billed annually. Use monthlyFee or annualFee.

earlyTerminationFeeUsd.description: Early-termination fee the vendor says you owe, USD, if any.

monthlyFee.description: What you pay per month, USD. Used to compute the dollars at stake.

termsUrl.description: Terms of Service or cancellation policy URL. Provide termsUrl or contractText.

userJurisdiction.description: e.g. California, New York, EU (Germany), UK.

name: contract-terminator
